BiblicalUsage: Sharuhen is a city in Judah allotted to Simeon, named once in the list of their cities: Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen, thirteen cities and their villages. The name means refuge of grace.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a refuge of grace is a good name for a town. Sharuhen is named once and never again, and I hold that God knows the towns that only get one verse.
